title: Floating Tree Bookshelves: Sizes, Finishes and Prices
meta_description: Floating tree bookshelves start at $314.00. Compare 19 solid wood branch designs, compact to wall-spanning sizes, wood finishes, and mounting requirements.
body_html:
A solid wood floating tree bookshelf from Wrydeco starts at $314.00 for a compact 15"W x 8"H x 8"D accent shelf. The right model depends on your available wall width, whether you need compact display space or multi-tier canopy storage, and how your wall studs align with the mounting bracket positions.

In this guide

  1. How does a floating tree branch shelf work on a wall?
  2. Which floating tree shelf size fits your space?
  3. Which solid wood finish should you select?
  4. How do compact accent shelves compare to full wall bookcases?
  5. Worked example: planning a floating tree shelf above a desk

How does a floating tree branch shelf work on a wall?

A floating tree bookshelf mounts directly to drywall with concealed structural brackets, allowing organic branch limbs to appear as if growing naturally across the wall surface without visible floor supports. Standard straight floating shelves provide one horizontal plane. A tree branch design creates multi-level display tiers at varying angles, offering dedicated spots for upright books, cascading plants, and decorative ceramics. Wrydeco's collection features 19 distinct designs priced from $314.00 to $7099.00, handcrafted from solid wood. You can browse all 19 floating tree bookshelves to compare branch densities and canopy widths.

How to apply it: inspect the target wall using a stud finder to identify the spacing of your wall studs. Standard floating tree shelves have mounting plates positioned along the main branch spine. Aligning these mounting anchors with structural studs ensures that your shelf can bear the weight of solid hardwood and books safely.

What to check

  • Stud spacing on your wall (typically 16 inches or 24 inches on center)
  • Obstructions such as wall switches, thermostat panels, or artwork
  • Vertical clearance above furniture surfaces (minimum 12 inches recommended)
  • Wall surface type (drywall, plaster, or exposed brick)

Which floating tree shelf size fits your space?

Wrydeco's floating branch collection spans from compact accent perches to expansive wall-filling canopies:

  • 15''W x 8''H x 8''D: starts at $314.00. Compact single-branch accent shelf for small decor or entryways.
  • 24''W x 16''H x 10''D: starts at $404.00. Two-tier branch accent for bedside or reading chair corners.
  • 30''W x 16''H x 10''D: starts at $554.00. Medium branch shelf for small personal book collections.
  • 45'' x 45'' x 10''D: starts at $1198.00. Versatile four-tier square canopy format.
  • 45"W x 45"H x 8"D: starts at $1553.00. Slimmer profile designed for hallways or tighter walkways.
  • 50"W x 45"H x 8"D to 89"W x 80"H x 10-12"D: architectural wall-spanning sizes starting from $3906.00 for expansive living rooms.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305869394010.jpg]

Depth is a critical factor: the 8" depth suits paperbacks and framed photos, while the 10" and 12" depths accommodate heavy hardcover books, binders, and substantial art objects.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305869426778.jpg]

How to apply it: mark the footprint of the branch shelf on your wall using painter's tape. Stand 8 to 10 feet back to judge the visual proportion against your room furniture. Ensure the branch tips leave at least 8 inches of clear drywall on all sides to maintain an airy, floating effect.

What to check

  • Total width and height of the clear wall area
  • Depth clearance to prevent bumps in high-traffic pathways
  • The size and weight of objects you plan to place on each limb
  • Whether custom sizing is needed for specific alcove dimensions

Which solid wood finish should you select?

The collection features nine wood finishes: Dark Walnut, Warm Wood, Dark Warm Wood, Cool Dark Wood, Natural Finish, Custom, Natural, Light Oak, and Walnut.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305880862810.jpg]

Starting prices vary by finish category on compact models:

  • Dark Walnut, Custom, Warm Wood, Dark Warm Wood, Cool Dark Wood, and Natural Finish: each start at $314.00 on the 15''W model.
  • Natural, Light Oak, and Walnut: each start at $1198.00 on larger multi-tier formats.
  • Natural and Natural Finish: show clear pale grain tones that blend effortlessly with minimalist and Scandinavian aesthetics.
  • Light Oak: adds a warm honey tone that complements light oak flooring and textured woven rugs.
  • Walnut and Warm Wood: provide versatile mid-tone amber and chestnut hues suited for classic interiors.
  • Dark Walnut and Dark Warm Wood: offer dramatic, deep brown tones that accentuate branch silhouettes against neutral walls.
  • Cool Dark Wood: features subdued charcoal-brown notes that complement monochrome palettes.
  • Custom: bespoke stain formulation configured to match existing architectural millwork.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305880895578.jpg]

How to apply it: examine the undertone of your wall paint and adjacent wood trim. Warm-toned walls (creams, warm beiges) pair naturally with Warm Wood or Walnut. Cool-toned walls (pure white, light gray) make Dark Walnut and Cool Dark Wood branches stand out as striking sculptural focal points.

What to check

  • Wall paint color and undertone (warm vs cool)
  • Finish of existing furniture within the same sightline
  • Amount of natural daylight reaching the installation wall
  • Contrast preference (subtle blending vs strong branch definition)

How do compact accent shelves compare to full wall bookcases?

Choosing between a compact branch shelf ($314.00 to $554.00) and a full-size tree bookcase ($1198.00 to $3906.00+) depends on your primary functional goal: accent styling versus serious book storage.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305881092186.jpg]

  • Compact Accent Shelves (15" to 30" width): lightweight and easy to mount on two wall studs. Built to hold 5 to 15 books alongside a potted trailing pothos or decorative ceramics. Perfect above home office desks or in bedrooms.
  • Full-Size Tree Bookcases (45" to 89" width): substantial architectural pieces weighing significantly more. Provide 4 to 8 tiers of spreading branches capable of supporting complete book collections, art volumes, and heavy decorative pieces. Require multiple stud anchor points.

On 45'' x 45'' models, self-assembly starts at $1198.00, while scheduled on-site installation is available starting at $1598.00 ($400.00 addition) for complete professional wall mounting.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305881124954.jpg]

How to apply it: count the volumes you intend to store. If you have fewer than 20 books and want an artistic wall accent, a 24" or 30" branch shelf delivers organic warmth at accessible pricing. If you need comprehensive storage for 50 or more books, invest in a 45" or 65" multi-tier model.

What to check

  • Number of books and items designated for the shelf
  • Structural anchor capacity of your wall
  • DIY installation confidence versus scheduling professional setup
  • Budget allocation between compact accents and major statement furniture

Worked example: planning a floating tree shelf above a desk

This worked example uses realistic hypothetical room dimensions to demonstrate how to choose the right floating tree shelf configuration.

Imagine a home office with an 8-foot (96") ceiling and a 60-inch wide wooden writing desk placed against a flat drywall wall. The owner wants to display reference books and plants without crowding desk space.

  1. Width selection: A 45"W x 45"H x 8"D unit fits naturally centered above the 60-inch desk. It leaves 7.5 inches of open wall margin on both sides of the desk footprint, creating a grounded visual pyramid.
  2. Height placement: Mounted 18 inches above the desk desktop (which sits at 30 inches), the bottom branch is at 48 inches from the floor, easily reachable while seated. The top branch tip reaches 93 inches, leaving 3 inches of breathing room below the 96-inch ceiling.
  3. Depth selection: An 8" depth ensures that open books, notebooks, and small desk lamps on the table surface remain completely unobstructed, while comfortably shelving 7" trade paperbacks.
  4. Finish selection: The desk is walnut and the room features soft beige walls. Choosing Walnut creates visual harmony between the floating branches and the workspace below.
  5. Cost calculation: The 45"W x 45"H x 8"D floating shelf in Walnut begins at $1553.00, providing four tiers of organic storage anchored securely into wall framing studs.
